cohort: Development on the previously studied personal12 menu of sub-04, all 120 rows. Four presentations per query. No selection by word correctness. If successful, confirm on sub-05 and sub-01.
question: Averaging eight images with different views can remove edges. Can an EEG-selected single low-resolution support view give diffusion a better starting composition than either averaging the supports or using a representative view?
selection: Freeze the mixed trial/Fisher word and matched native H/14 direction. Use only the eight images in that word's registered off-fold support. Rank unit author H/14 embeddings by cosine to the frozen own direction. Select maximum, first on a tie. The medoid control maximizes cosine to the native uniform direction; exchanged control uses the original word/fold donor's direction. The average control is a pixelwise mean over all eight support thumbnails. Only off-fold support images may enter these starts.
generation: Area-average each 512-square support crop to RGB32, then upsample the selected or averaged thumbnail to 512 with bilinear interpolation. Encode its VAE posterior mode. All four starts share the matched recipient's H/14 direction and predicted word, IP-Adapter, 923761+row seed and the same two Euler ancestral steps [499,249] on the native four-step Turbo grid. Compare separately to the already frozen full four-step ordinary generation. The thumbnail establishes coarse appearance; inference never accesses the viewed original.
evaluation: Reopen all blind JPEGs. Use the fixed DINOv2-S/14 original gallery and CLIP-L/14 12- and 1854-word naming. Primary photo outcome is target top one of all ten photos of the true object including the eight possible supports. For diagnosis also score the two wholly held-out alternatives independently and jointly on pairs where both words were correct, actual target cosine, RGB32 RMSE and luminance correlation. Measure attraction to the selected support. Use 10000 paired bootstrap draws of the twelve object identities, seed 260569. Publish totals including mistakes and fixed first-row examples. Advance only if matched ten-way photo recognition exceeds native, pixel mean and medoid, has a positive lower bound versus the exchanged view, and full-vocabulary hits at least match native. Store every arm even when the gate fails.
